name_reason: Descriptive and accurate (battle melee-attack precondition check); no Ghidra address residue; consistent with sibling battle helper naming (fd2_find_equipped_item_by_kind, fd2_get_item_effect_entry) that use descriptive names without a strict _battle_ infix.
purpose: Precheck whether a runtime char can launch a default (melee) physical attack on a given tile; used by enemy AI to decide if an AoE target could counter-attack (counter-bonus gate).
logic_summary: rc = runtime_char[char_idx]. Fail (-1) if rc.status_sleep_flag != 0 (asleep). Compute Manhattan distance dx=abs(tile_x-rc.pos_x), dy=abs(tile_y-rc.pos_y); fail if dx+dy != 1 (must be orthogonally adjacent). weapon_slot = find_equipped_item_by_kind(char_idx, 0=physical); fail if -1 (no weapon). weapon_id = inventory_slot_item_id; weapon_entry = item_effect_entry(weapon_id); fail if weapon_entry[0xB] (R1 = min attack range) > 1 (bow/staff cannot melee). Else return 1.
signature: int __cdecl fd2_check_can_default_attack_target(uint32 char_idx, uint32 tile_x, uint32 tile_y)

params.name: param_1
params.semantics: runtime_char index whose default-attack capability is being tested (caller passes the AoE target's index).
params.reason: Ghidra name param_1 is a generic placeholder; src already uses char_idx which matches usage as index into data_fd2_battle_runtime_char_array_ptr.

params.name: param_2
params.semantics: Target tile X coordinate (caller passes attacker's candidate tile x); compared to rc.pos_x for adjacency.
params.reason: Generic placeholder param_2; src uses tile_x matching the abs(tile_x - pos_x) adjacency computation.

params.name: param_3
params.semantics: Target tile Y coordinate (caller passes attacker's candidate tile y); compared to rc.pos_y for adjacency.
params.reason: Generic placeholder param_3; src uses tile_y matching the abs(tile_y - pos_y) adjacency computation.

returns.semantics: 1 = can default-attack the tile; -1 = cannot (asleep / not adjacent / no weapon / weapon min range > 1).
